Plugin.Name: unCommander
Plugin.Overview: Two-pane, Midnight Commander-style file manager for the Unraid web UI, with background file operations, trash and undo, batch renaming, folder comparison, and built-in maintenance tools.
Plugin.Description: unCommander is a two-pane, Midnight Commander-style file manager for the Unraid web UI. Browse two folders side by side and copy, move, rename, delete, compress, extract, and compare files using taps or F-keys. Copies and moves run in the background with progress; deleted files can be sent to a restorable trash, and many actions can be undone. Features include batch renaming with live preview, file viewing and editing with syntax highlighting, folder sizes, practice mode, an optional whole-system view, a Midnight Commander theme, per-device text size, and tools to find empty leftover folders, movie folders missing their video files, and TV shows with missing episodes.
